values: Update the Wine Data tab each quarter. The dashboard reads the published CSV automatically.
Use one row for each wine in each club tier. Set row_type to allocation.
Use one row for each Anniversary, Milestone, or Referral bottle. Set row_type to member.
Paste the Google Drive viewer link into tech_sheet. Leave blank until verified.
program_order controls the club order. tier_order controls tier order inside each club.
Do not rename the column headers. Do not add passwords or customer information.
